<style>
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: "Lucida Console", monospace;
}

.header {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 32px 16px 12px;
}

.row1 {
  --cols: 6;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--cols), minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 0 4px;
}

.column1 {
  min-width: 0;
}

.column1 img,
.column1 video,
.column1 iframe,
.column1 embed {
  width: 100%;
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.btn {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  background-color: #f1f1f1;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.btn:hover {
  background-color: #ddd;
}

.btn.active {
  background-color: #666;
  color: white;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 800px) {
  .row1 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  function countColumns(row) {
    var n = 0;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(row.children, function (child) {
      if (child.classList && child.classList.contains("column1")) {
        n++;
      }
    });
    return n || 1;
  }

  function setActive(header, activeBtn) {
    var buttons = header.querySelectorAll(".btn");
    buttons.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.classList.remove("active");
    });
    if (activeBtn) {
      activeBtn.classList.add("active");
    }
  }

  function setColumns(row, n) {
    row.style.setProperty("--cols", String(n));
  }

  document.querySelectorAll(".grid-toggle").forEach(function (header) {
    var row = header.nextElementSibling;
    if (!row || !row.classList.contains("row1")) return;

    var available = countColumns(row);
    setColumns(row, Math.min(6, available));

    var buttons = header.querySelectorAll(".btn");
    buttons.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var n = parseInt(btn.getAttribute("data-cols"), 10);
        if (!n) return;
        setColumns(row, Math.min(n, available));
        setActive(header, btn);
      });
    });

    var init = header.querySelector('.btn[data-cols="2"]') || buttons[0];
    setActive(header, init);
  });
});
</script>
